description.value: A family-run neighbourhood bike shop on Cook Street in Victoria, operating since 2002. They carry touring-oriented brands like Surly, Salsa, and Brompton alongside Marin, Cannondale, and Tern cargo/e-bikes, and stock components from Rohloff, Sturmey Archer, Schwalbe, and other touring-relevant makers. Their mechanics are certified on Bosch and Shimano STePS e-bike systems and welcome everything from vintage Peugeots to modern carbon race bikes.
